# Project Design Context

ChatLogix vendor web app: WhatsApp commerce SaaS. Calm navy product UI with a WhatsApp-green accent — not a generic indigo dashboard.

## Project

- Name: chatlogix
- Product type: WhatsApp e-commerce SaaS (vendor dashboard + public signup/onboarding)
- Stack: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS 3, Turborepo (`frontend_v2/apps/web-vendor`)
- Color mode: light
- Density: comfortable
- Font: Inter

Source of truth: `frontend_v2/packages/design-tokens/src/index.ts`.

21st community themes are **inspiration only**. Do not drop their `:root` CSS into `index.css`. Map shadcn classes with `design.tailwindAliases` in `design.json`.

## 21st MCP

Namespace: `user-21st`.

1. Read this file + `.21st/design.json`.
2. `get_inspiration` with `context` = design.json (layout/patterns).
3. `search` / `search_picker` with `type: "theme"` then `get_theme` (palette ideas; free).
4. Reuse `@chatlogix/ui` first. `get_component` is metered — only after a clear fit.
5. `generate` only if nothing fits; pass the same `context`. Rebuild from the copy-prompt, do not paste sketch HTML.

Shadcn-shaped CSS for 21st previews lives in `.21st/chatlogix-theme.css`. It is **not** loaded by the Vite app.

## Components

- Installed primitives: Button, Input, Card, Badge, Modal (`frontend_v2/packages/ui`)
- Signup: `SignupMarketingPanel` + form column
- Onboarding: `OnboardingLayout` 60/40 split + `OnboardingGuidePanel`

## Constraints

### Must

- Navy for brand chrome and primary buttons; green for success / WhatsApp / secondary CTAs
- Light surfaces, Inter, `rounded-lg` controls, `rounded-xl` cards
- Pass design.json as 21st `context`

### Avoid

- Pasting 21st theme CSS into the running app
- Treating shadcn `secondary` as muted gray
- Dark mode, glass, purple-blue AI gradients, extra primary hues
- Adding shadcn as a dependency unless asked

## Decisions

- Brand pair is navy + WhatsApp green
- Tokens ship as Tailwind scales, not CSS variables
- 21st is for layout/interaction patterns, not a palette takeover
- Signup/onboarding: one job per screen; demo preview card (catalog + chat + voice) is the signup product picture
- Public `/signup` is trust-first: experience the AI with your own store; a ₹50 free trial balance makes it risk-free. Do not lead with ₹50 as the only headline.
- Public `/signup` desktop: light gray marketing column + full-white form column (no card)
- Signup demo preview is a chat-app window (header, composer, stepper) plus a quality-test callout
- Onboarding catalog: after upload, vendors review/correct extracted products as stacked cards, then save. Extra uploads collapse; skip is only before products exist.
- Shop onboarding: Save & continue stays sticky at the bottom of the form.
- Onboarding **demo** (`/onboarding/demo-chat`) is a real customer WhatsApp phone: desktop chassis, mobile full-screen. Wallet ₹ and Continue stay outside the device. Signup preview remains the existing chat-app window, not a bezel.
- **Intake-first funnel (P3):** OTP → catalog → clarify (gap questions) → confirm (pre-filled shop + greeting) → WhatsApp demo phone → submit. Email optional until submit.
- Clarify: one question per screen, ChoiceChips, “That’s enough” ghost CTA, progress tied to ≥80% completeness score.
- Demo: `WhatsAppDemoPhone` — customer WA chrome, hold-to-record, typing/ticks; trial cost outside the device frame.
- Stepper: Catalog / Details / Confirm / Demo / Submit. `/onboarding/welcome` and `/onboarding/ai-setup` redirect.
- **Marketing site:** separate app `frontend_v2/apps/web-marketing` (local `:3002`, later `chatlogix.in`). Try Free / Login are absolute `<a href>` links to the vendor portal (`VITE_VENDOR_APP_ORIGIN`, local `:3000`, later `app.chatlogix.in`). No marketing routes inside `web-vendor`. No auth or API client on the marketing app.
- **Marketing hero:** pain-first headline (repeat questions, order context), three SVG bullets, Before/After tabbed chat preview on the right.
- **Marketing How it Works (desktop):** intro + trust/highlights sit as a full-width split. The five step mocks share one row height; connecting arrows sit on the mock cards, not the titles.
- **Marketing type scale:** Hero, Problem, Solution, and How it Works share eyebrow / heading / body sizes from `pageLayout.ts`.
- **Marketing FAQ:** Accordion answers overlay in place (absolute) so the snap section height does not change. Homepage footer is a single black bar attached to the bottom of `#faq`.
- **Marketing header:** Same canvas as the hero (`#f8f9fa`), mint circular chat mark, Plus Jakarta wordmark in navy + teal, pill nav, navy Try Free → CTA.
- **Onboarding setup split:** Catalog / Details / Confirm / Demo / Submit use the signup 60/40 light split. Left is coaching (what this step is, how to use it). Right is the work.
- **Signup copy is job-first:** `Try it on your catalog` + `Send code`. the ₹50 trial balance is helper text under the field — never the H1, a green badge, or the only CTA. Trust lines, a visible FAQ heading, and Terms/Privacy are on the page, not `sr-only`.
- **Shared public auth split:** `/signup` and `/login` both render `PublicAuthSplit` (light gray marketing column + full-white form column) with `SignupDemoPreview`. No dark navy login wall. OTP boxes are thumb-sized and auto-submit on the sixth digit.
- **Catalog product rows:** one line per product (name, ₹ price, unit/qty, Edit / Remove), one row expanded at a time, description collapsed by default. Upload splits into equal **Take photo** and **Upload file** actions. A zero-product extract leads with *Add 3 items by hand*; Skip stays but warns the assistant cannot quote prices.
- **Clarify starts empty:** no chip preselected, Continue disabled until answered, progress reads `Detail N of 5` plus one line on why it matters.
- **Confirm grouping:** Shop facts / How it sounds (assistant name, greeting, live phone mock), personality as chips. Approval email is collected here, not as an amber surprise on Review.
- **Demo soft gate:** chat is primary; `Continue to review` stays ghost until one assistant reply, an empty wallet, or a skipped catalog. Never a hard block.
- **Submitted timeline:** Submitted → In review → Approved → Connect WhatsApp, plus a *While you wait* list. Edit application goes to `/onboarding/confirm`.
- **Numbered stepper:** header steps are circles — done = navy-outlined check on white, current = filled `primary-500`, ahead = `gray-100` / `gray-400`, joined by short rules that turn navy once passed. Labels from `lg`; circles only at `md`. Mobile keeps the five-segment bars.
- **One title per viewport:** mobile compact guide is kicker + H1 only so the control is above the fold. The desktop right-column `actionTitle` is a `text-xl` `h2` and is dropped when it restates the left H1.
- **Wallet chip:** navy `Badge` pill reading `₹N trial left` (whole rupees, `formatTrialLeft`). Per-reply cost keeps two decimals.
- **Skeletons, not "Loading…":** `OnboardingActionSkeleton` fills the right column of the 60/40 split; `OnboardingPageSkeleton` reproduces the whole split for `ProtectedRoute` (`onboardingOnly`). Pulse is `motion-safe`.
- **Help never disappears:** `NeedHelpFooter` always shows "Questions?" and resolves `VITE_SUPPORT_WHATSAPP` → `VITE_SUPPORT_EMAIL` → `https://chatlogix.in`. Both vars live in `frontend_v2/apps/web-vendor/.env.example`.
- **Rupees, never "credits":** wallet money is millirupees and formats with `formatWalletAmount`; order/product/revenue money stays paise and formats with `formatAmountWithSymbol`. Keep the two formatters apart — swapping them is a 10x error.
- **Wallet-first dashboard:** `WalletBalanceCard` (balance, spend this month, Add money CTA) replaces the credits card. `SpendBreakdownChart` and `SpendTrendChart` show rupees; no plan quota or "% of limit".
- **Admin vendors:** `web-admin` `/vendors` is a searchable list beside a detail panel (wallet balance, markup editor with a worked example, recent wallet activity), built from `@chatlogix/ui` on navy + green.
- **Admin billing:** `web-admin` `/billing` is stacked setting cards (FX, fees, trial, catalog caps, top-up). Admins type rupees; the API stores paise. Same Card/Button chrome as the vendor markup editor.
- **Dashboard operations bento:** `/dashboard` prioritizes needs-attention, recent conversations/orders, and a slim wallet + 2×2 quick actions rail; pulse tiles are compact (no gradient KPI cards). Analytics section appears only when there is wallet spend or multiple order statuses.
- **WhatsApp Connect wizard:** `/settings/whatsapp` uses a four-step stepper, path cards, guide panel on desktop, and shared checklist styling — same navy + green as onboarding.
- **Grid app shell:** the vendor shell is an `h-dvh` grid (`grid-rows-[auto_1fr]`) with no viewport arithmetic. `main` is the only scroller; the footer is gone and its copyright/version live in the sidebar base. Layering is header `z-30`, backdrop `z-40`, drawer `z-50`. `Conversations` cancels the `p-4 lg:p-6` padding with `-m-4 lg:-m-6` and must track it.
- **Header carries wallet and page context:** one `h-14` row — hamburger, logo, page label from `pageTitles.ts` (longest route prefix wins), wallet chip from `useVendorConfig` (amber under ₹20), and a single avatar-initials menu holding Settings, Support and Logout.
- **Grouped sidebar with icon rail:** Operations / Catalog / Account groups, `currentColor` SVG icons so the active item tints, a 2px navy left rail, `Soon` spans for the unrouted Templates and Support, and a desktop collapse to a 16-unit rail persisted at `chatlogix:sidebar-collapsed`.
- **Marketing Pricing:** estimate calculator (pay-as-you-go monthly spend hint), not plan tiers. `/#pricing` is the calculator; the trial section is `#try`. The result card carries a four-point promise (instant replies, one order portal, keep shop WhatsApp, take over any chat).
- **Orders list and detail:** shorter four-number strip (Need attention, Collected). One toolbar: Today/Week/Month is a white segmented control with navy text and a navy border when selected; sort is a solid white menu (`z-30`), not a native select. Table columns are Order, Customer, Payment, Fulfillment, Amount, When. The one filled button is navy. Green badges are paid/success only. Cancel is red text. Payment choices sit in the order rail, not a modal.
